title.narrative: Zero Hunger And Mortality in Shwegu and Mansi

description.narrative: ltpgtWCM conducted a rapid assessment, which underscored the dire situation.1)50% of 2,956 households (HH) had at least one child and an interval of 2-3 years between 2 children, indicating family planning (FP) needs. 2)1,744 HH with 9,322 people from 6 villages (Vs) of Shwegu (S) fled their Vs because SAC navy boats travelled along the Ayeyarwaddy river burnt their houses with shells. 783 HH (44.9%) needed shelters, bed-nets and blankets. 501 HH (42.4%) from Mansi(M) township needed repairing shelters and warm clothing. 3)8 Vs from M and 6 Vs from S faced shortage of food. Low yield of rice, corn and sesame, and armed conflicts made insufficient supply of food. 4)TB cases were reported in 8 Vs of M and 4 Vs of S. Malarias cases were reported in 8 Vs of M and 5 Vs of S. MHAA, MCC, AZG, KBC and IRC tested Malaria and gave medication in 7 Vs/Cs of M but there was no service provider in S. TB cases were treated in M, S and Bhamaw hospitals. 5)FP services and financial support for delivery were provided for 4 Vs of M by MHAA, and ANC, FP and support for delivery were provided in 3 Cs of M by KBC and IRC. There was no MNCH service provider for 11 Vs/Cs in S and M. 3 Vs/Cs of M and 5 Vs of S relied on Trained Birth Attendance (TBA) for delivery. 6)Diarrhea occurred in 7 Vs/Cs of M and 2 Vs of S. Acute respiratory infection (ARI) occurred in 4 Vs/Cs of M and 4 Vs of S. Diarrhea prevalence was up to 25% in rainy season and ARI prevalence was as high as 20% to 25%.lt/pgtltpgtWCM, 2 local CSOs, 17 Cs/Vs committees and 28 community-based volunteers (CBW) will implement comprehensive, integrated, multi-sectorial/-location and complementary interventions in 2 townships of Kachin state. Participatory Learning and Action(PLA) and Participatory Action Research(PAR) methods will play a pivotal role in mobilizing affected populations in every step of Project Cycle Management (PCM). The following specific key strategies will collectively contribute towards the intended objectives, benefitting 14,823 populations with more than 85% women and girls, and 90% highly vulnerable groups, including PWD, senior citizens and women headed households. Key project activities will include:1) Community-based surveillance for health issues, child rights and EOR will gather and feed information for design and implementation of intervention. 2) Undertake SBCC for mothers of under 5 children, parents of children under 18 and population at-risks regarding health, protection, and EOR. 3) Set up mobile clinics and equip CBW in conjunction with a referral system to provide life-saving and primary health care services encompassing health, and protection services. 4) Run community-based services to complement clinical services through making protection, counseling, MHPSS and NFI available. 5) Arrange CVA around food and agriculture/livestock assistance to help target population access nutritious food groups. ltbrgtThe proposed project is aligned to allocation strategies. 1.WCM and 2 indigenous NGOs with prior experience in working in 2 townships partnered through equitable partnership, resource sharing, enhancing capacity and adequate participation of affected people. 2. Employ PLA, PAR and CFM methods to optimize involvement of PWD, women, and other most vulnerable groups in the entire PCM to enhance AAP and inclusion of and benefits for PWD and other vulnerable groups. 3. Ensure zero tolerance to PSEA via using the existing WCM’s PSEA mechanism tailored to specific needs of beneficiaries. 4. Child protection, GBV and EORE will be mainstreamed through training and supporting all staff/volunteers/ committees in incorporating detailed implementation plans of protection issues for all sectors. 5. Conflict sensitivity will be an integral part through assessing conflicts drivers and dividers by gender lens and developing a context specific plan and implementing it with involvement of all diverse groups. 6. CVA will be used to increase access to nutritious food by beneficiaries. ltbrgtlt/pgt
